messages:
Marta: Heads-up — seeing recurring tail-latency spikes in dedicated slices that line up with egress bursts and slab fragmentation. Not a one-off.
Samir: Can you paste the p95/p99 and a short description of what you saw?
Marta: p95 jumps from ~45ms -> 320ms; p99 up to ~1.2s during bursts. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/grafana/d/egress-burst (times around 1719876498-1719876560)
Jia: Any tenant correlation / noisy neighbor suspects?
Marta: Yes — mobile-vision-heavy tenant shows sustained 3x token rate for ~20s. NIC tx queues saturate, and we observe PCIe DMA burst spikes.
Andre: Sounds like the us-west pattern from last month. Host-level egress + slab fragmentation tends to amplify kvcache regen.
Ops-bot: Deploy completed at 1719876500 - rolling-update/gpu-runtime v2.11
Samir: Can you drop a short log snippet from the host side and kvcache counters?
Marta: Paste logs from the 60s window:
```
[1719876499.123] if_tx_queue_len=4096 tx_drops=0 tx_bytes=1.2GB
[1719876502.556] pci_dma_burst=1.3GB/s irq_lat=120us
kvcache: miss_ratio=0.78 regen_rate=120/s regen_peak=300/s
```
Jia: When NIC bursts, kernel queueing + IRQ spikes -> scheduler backpressure -> GPU kernel stalls -> massive kvcache regen. Mitigation ideas (quick):
- soft egress policer (rate cap) per-tenant during detected bursts
- slab lane drain for offending tenant to reduce fragmentation
- route tenant to spare capacity/region as temporary fallback
- kernel IRQ coalescing and NIC shaping knobs
Andre: Cost-wise, carving out dedicated slices for this tenant reduces noisy neighbor risk but increases committed cost. Soft policing is cheaper short-term.
Samir: Routing to eu1 spare would help isolation but violates RTT SLO for mobile-vision-heavy (they need <200ms tails).
Marta: Confirmed: eu1 RTT adds ~60ms median — breaks client SLO.
Jia: Proposal: run a short canary policy — apply 30% token-rate cap for 60s at 1719876600 to see effect. ops-sre to approve.
ops-sre: Approved. Apply the cap and monitor. :thumbsup:
Ops-bot: Policy applied: tenant-ratecap mobile-vision-heavy=30% duration=60s at 1719876605
Marta: After cap: p95 down to ~58ms, p99 ~220ms. kvcache regen reduced but still above baseline.
Andre: Good signal. Next medium-term steps: automate prefill-aware egress shaper, add safe NIC IRQ coalescing patch to kernel config, and implement automatic slab-carve when tx_queue_len > 2048 for >10s.
Samir: I'll spin up a follow-up ticket for runbook + long-term automation + cost modeling. Tagging @Finance for carveout pricing impact.
Finance: Noted. Send estimated idle hours and monthly run-rate delta for analysis.
Marta: I'll open PERF-4572 with the traces, logs, and proposed PR for shaper/kernel tweak.
Jia: Thanks — short-term cap bought us stability. Leaving thread open for the automation PR and cost analysis.
